book.name: Yonna Yesusmoa.
book.title: Yonna Yesusmoa. Yonmba Ishomnavna Yesusm, Sesoana Ombolm.

content: Lasarusmba Dahana.
Mongo tendorini lohvna, nihilva henamba Lasarus, wo hemba uvavulm dihelvna. Himba di avna Betani kembella, di ten ahavna muskovol sambla Mariai Martai.
Mariava no ungevlirini, dawonamba he si welsandava sovhomnavav mendeklimba, wo hevna tana sowol venavav. Mariana muskovolva Lasarus lohvna, wo doa hemba daipotava uvavulm dihelvna.
Wo Mariaiva Martaiva evenamba, mongom ewulihanga, ishomnalm Yesusm, omnana, nomba sehpevpa, yimba temba hemba mindnamba und velohvpa, uvavulm dihelv.

Wo nomba Yesusva ona hellena, hev unna, nomba uvavulva temba venavpa, osm hemba wohdahavavmoa. Temba ambo osm, indhanamba nunglivra pusambakambam Sesoanam, wo nihilm wulovolmanavra. Eva honamba memba osm temba vei, popeng vrelm Sesoana ombolm.
Yesusva mindnam und vewol vevna Martam, hevna moasalalm, eva Lasarusm.
Wo heva os nonamba himba osva hellenamba, ona, Lasarusva uvavulm dihelv, himba diva henga dawonam samblanin vewolna.
Wo doa Yesus unna hevtindim, henga angalohra Yutia provinsram.
Wo hevtindi una, heva os Yutanindva diva yemba honnam helvakomandhalm vivna. Mani doarama, owai. Wo yimba hengam dom galm ov?

Wo henga Yesus opla vrinna, owai, eneha ata ye andram nongthovav, mendah nambaiva lohv. Mongova indhanariniva lohmana vetava okombanamba, hemba lomotat vepevavmoa, manara noinda himba nonglav hona woklamba petharinimba.
Wo heva os mongova lohmana vetava sinimba, hemba lomotat vepevav, manara noinda manakambara eva ata himba nov vevta.
Honamba Yesusva ishopianamba, wo henga hev unna, pina sehelva Lasarusva ninpol kovopei ambo. Heva os kava gav domba, deuhvholm ninmerinim.
Wo hevtindi umnina, heva os himba ninmba litava, osva henamba uvavulva hemba si wuleihavav.
Yesusva osm unvna, doa Lasarusmba dahana. Heva os hevtindiva os ningvna, Yesusva ambo ov, osva Lasarusva ninpol kovopei.
Wo doa Yesusva moakus unvna, unna, Lasarusmba doa dahana.

Heva os kava yem ninginv, eva ka vei, indk vethav, osva kava heiva mongawulmba ahanamoa. Manara, noinda ata yimba kamba undnahonamba wohlovahthamnavav mindnam honindava. Wo doa pioa angavai heindam daipota.
Yesusva ishopianamba, wo doa Tomas, mongova henamba nihilva Ditimus, hev unna owalm, pioa angavaita, pimba si dalvra hemongo.
Yesusva Ona, Phona Plalva, Kava Men Kav Lohv.
Yesusva phonamba Betanira. Di himba hellevna, osva Lasarusmba doa dahana, wo honmerava os vindilna, 4pelara okombava lohmanana.
Betaniva mani ehallama, ambo lohvna murapeta Yerusalemrava, 3pelara kilomita ambo.
Wo noinda osva Yutanindva esvema pulningewolvna Mariaimba Martaimba, osm noinda undwonam ahavra, doa daheinna henamba muskovolmba.
Martava helle, ona, Yesusva doa di prov, wo himba deuvriniva venamba, monaram gavna, suwihalm Yesusm. Mariaoa di ana deuvra.
Marta omnana Yesusm, doarava yimba huiva atava, kana muskovolmba ata dahatamoa.
Heva os kava nonora av, osva eva daipotava yimba sahmanatava mana vemamba Sesoamba, yemba vraohvav.
Yesus omnana, yenamba muskopevpa si phovav, wo henga si beswonam avav.
Marta ophona, kava nonora, osva himba si henga phovav, nonam ovi pethai hoai evewolvram, nonamba Sesoava nambavrava.
Yesus omnana Martam, phona plalva, kava men kav lohv. Himba nomba temba kamba keknamba undnahonamba lovahthamnavpa, himba si yunalm wohavra, eva hemba dalvra.
Wo hindva nomba memba avpa, himba keknamba kamba lovahthamnavrava, si hemba dalvramoa. Marta, yimba keknam nengvma honamba?
Marta ophona, kava keknam amnav honamba, osra yimba Kristus, Sesoana ombol. Yimba noi, ten hom pronam hona petharam.
Yesusva Lasarusm Wivevna.
Martava osva ishopianamba honamba, hev ganamba, omnana moasalalm Mariam dendwolla, protok. Doa pina guruva men einv, wo himba yemba osahei.
Nomba Mariava ona osva hellena, himba phonamba lelnam, os wohgana Yesusindamba.
Yesusva mendah sihapra vevnamoa kembellamba. Himba mendah di vevna, ten Marta nonglaphonam monara.
Yutanindva waiaevulvna Mariamba di deuvmora silembakombam. Yutanindva nunglivna, doa lelnam wohpho, wo himba osoa wohpatvmonavna hemba. Himba os ningna, Mariava gav pokamaram dom, wenam owolm.
Heva os Mariava dom gavna, di ten Yesus avnam. Nonamba Mariava ona nonglana hemba, vendpenamba Yesusna monglasra, hev omnana, yimba doarava huiva atava, ata kana muskovmba dahatamoa osva.
Yesusva nonglana, Mariava wivev, wo eva Yutanindva nomba nungwulimbnamba, himba eva wuovnata. Wo Yesusva eva wosava innemolla lohna, wo himba eva wivelm vevnata.
Hev osihinna, hi yimba singvina hemba? Hev umnina, prorava, nonglo.
Yesusva wem osevravna.
Wo Yutanindva una, nunglu, eva mani eskandma, himba mindnam hevm und vev hemba.
Wo mongla una, Yesusva novtitmungilm sishona vewol vena doa, wo himba nov viv, wo eva eselm himba hona indhanarinimba kolvramba owai vena, osmba ata homeis hem dahavm?
Yesusva Henga Wolaihaphona Pokamarini Lasarusmba.
Yesusmba wavrava mendekli snal venavna i. Hev provna pokamaramba. Pokamava nomba honme mendekli, wo henga mongo hon velapathalohvna no mengallava.
Yesus unna, kihliheiu honm ehallam. Marta omnana, heva os mendekli, doa 4pelara simba penngiliha vungana, hemba os dahana. Ata nungva sahoklal vevav. Martava Lasarusmindna muskovolnonoa.
Wo hemba Yesusva omnana, doa yemba kava seilm ten ishomni, yimba kamba amnatava keknamba, ata yimba nonglavav pusambava Sesoanamba.
Wo doa himba os tuvriniva honmba kihliheina, wo Yesusva nov vevongo venamba, hev ona, ara, kava yemba os omnav, yimba lehra, yimba doa kamba hellei.
Kava nonora lohv, osva yimba elsus kamba hellellohv. Heva os kava ov honamba, noinda indhana, men doa kamba pulningei. Kava vinv osm hemba, heoa levrapieira honamoa, osra yepev kamba wolaihaprana.
Yesusva honamba osva ishopianamba, hev mindnam vevandnam onam, Lasarus, pholahangao.
Wo no mindva os wohphona, doara ten ninginam kayenna, nonahonam wohphona, eva novlomosm nom ningimninam. Yesus unna, selvowol vinirava kayenmoa, os nis gara.
Kuwulna Mundilnamba Moa Mokeltheivna, Yesusm Helvakomandhalm.
Nomba Yutanindva, temba waiaevulalm prowonamba Mariamba, nunglina, ona, os vev Yesusva. Wo mindnam himba keknam lovahthamnavna hemba.
Heva os monglava Yutanindva anginvna Varisinindindam. Anganamba, nom temura ishunvna Varisinindm himba, ten Yesus venam.

Wo doa vena, sembayang andranindna kuwul, eva Varisinind, himba moamba wulvahvna, kusopho velm, moam ishunilm nom kuwulm. Hev una, si pimba es vivav? Hona indhanariniva mindnam mendekliandrava vewol vev.
Pimba hemba nombolvhueitava, os ora, hvaomanakavra honamba manimani osva, indkumbiva si hemba tovopethamnavav, keknam undnahonam alm. Wo Romnindva si ambrava, pina tempelduvmba muehvinvav pivnahonam.
Mongova indhanariniva di doara avna, nihilva henamba Kaiapas. He no tahonnamba sembayang andranindna kuwulva luhunvna. Kaiapas unna, yimba hona indhanamba memba owai, mana vemamba levrapivolvmoa.
Temba lehra, osva mongawa indhanarinim ambo daheinvav indkumbimba, si homeis indkumbim indkokla vilovm. Heva os yimba levrapivolvnamoa honamba beswonamba.

Kaiapasva honamba moamba hevna nengavnangnamba ishovnamoa owai. Noinda osva ishovna, himba nonamba sembayang andranindna kuwul wulluhunvna no tahonnamba. Wo osva himba no moamba ishunvna, osva Yesusmba si daheinvav, Yutanindmba kolvrowolalmba,
eva indkumbim Sesoana towandalm, nom ten pethara vavawonam eungu vevm, osm si os himba mongawa moshrava kilihavav.
Wo no okombanamba Yutanindna kuwulna mundilnamba doa moamba mokeltheivna, helvakomandhalmba Yesusmba.

Wo doa Yesusva owai, bambanam muserava Yutanindrava lohmana vevnamoa. Himba nominiva venamba, os gana mongnavhoram dom murapetam sahal petharam. Himba gana mongona kembellam, os ningthiv Evraim, wo di wonavna hevtindimba.

Pasovatihva murapeta phunvna, nom nengewuvulm, Sesoa ten Israelnindm wonphonam. Indkumbiva no kembellini, no kembellini, os provna Yerusalemba no tihramba. Himba angavna, hevm vendwolaihawolalm, osm ora, kakowa lehrangas Sesoana novrava av.
Wo doa indhanamba etapewulungu vevna Yesusmba. Himba di tempelduvra lovahthavnamba, asahmana ungu vevna owalm, es hevpa himba provma hona tihramba? Es yimba ningwul vev?

Heva os doa vena, sembayang andranindna kuwul, eva Varisinind doa moamba vivrina heindamba. Hev una, os himba nomba nonorava lohtava, osva ora, ten Yesusva nolhra, heoa ishunda kamoa. Wo himba osva ata beswonam hemba kevrivav.
